query:
UPDATE contacts
                        SET first_name = $3, last_name = $4,
                            title = $5, email = $6, phone = $7,
                            mobile = $8, is_primary = $9, notes = $10,
                            version = version + 1
                      WHERE id = $1 AND customer_id = $2
                        AND version = $11
                     RETURNING version
